scripts.dev: pnpm prepare:sidecars && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec tauri dev
scripts.build: pnpm prepare:sidecars --release && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec tauri build --bundles app
scripts.check: node scripts/check-version.mjs && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm --filter @daygrid/ui build
scripts.test: pnpm prepare:sidecars && pnpm --filter @daygrid/ui build && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.test:mcp: cargo build -p daygrid --bins && cargo run -p daygrid --example mcp-smoke
